annotation.title_clean: Advanced robotics and artificial intelligence for the automation of tasks at work: current status and considerations for OSH
annotation.title_en: Advanced robotics and artificial intelligence for the automation of tasks at work: current status and considerations for OSH
annotation.authors_or_issuer: EU-OSHA (European Agency for Safety and Health at Work)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA highlight page (April 2022) announcing its report on advanced robotics and AI for automating workplace tasks. The report defines technologies, maps uses across sectors, reviews EU and national policies and strategies, and a policy brief offers a task-based taxonomy for assessing occupational safety and health opportunities and challenges.
key_provisions_or_claims: Workplace automation is rising, creating OSH opportunities and challenges.
Report defines types of AI and advanced robotics for task automation.
Maps current and potential uses from industrial and warehouse robots to healthcare AI software.
Overviews EU and national policies and strategies.
Policy brief proposes a task-based taxonomy to assess OSH impacts.
